item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00046","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C17","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 is a clear material drafting template for the child. It concerns the same transferor and transferee, uses the same section-by-section machinery to transfer Canal facilities and associated personnel, property, records, assets, contracts, obligations, and liabilities, and contains a nearly identical statutory deemed-acceptance provision. The child expands and adapts that earlier partial transfer into a broader reorganization while preserving distinctive language and administrative structure. C17 and C11 also use parallel transfer machinery, but their language is less specifically aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There are hereby transferred to the Panama Railroad Company, a corporate agency and instrumentality of the United States ... (a) the Panama Canal (the waterway), together with all the facilities, buildings, structures, and improvements related thereto","parent_excerpt":"The following-described buildings in the Canal Zone, now owned by The Panama Canal ... are hereby transferred to the Panama Railroad Company","explanation":"Both directives transfer specifically enumerated Canal property from The Panama Canal to the Panama Railroad Company using the same operative formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"There are hereby transferred to the Panama Railroad Company (a) all property ... (b) all records, (c) all other assets, and (d) all contracts obligations, and liabilities of The Panama Canal","parent_excerpt":"there are hereby transferred to the Panama Railroad Company all of the personnel, property ... records, related assets, contracts, obligations, and liabilities","explanation":"The child closely reuses C23's distinctive bundle of transferred administrative interests, expanding it from particular operations to the broader Canal organization."},{"child_excerpt":"The transfers to the Panama Railroad Company made by this order shall, as provided by law, be deemed to have been accepted and assumed by the said company without the necessity of any act or acts on the part of the company except as otherwise stipulated in section 246 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code","parent_excerpt":"The transfer ... accomplished by this order shall, as provided by law, be deemed to have been accepted and assumed by the Panama Railroad Company without the necessity of any act or acts on the part of the said Company except as otherwise stipulated ... including the provisions of section 246 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code","explanation":"This is highly distinctive, nearly verbatim legal machinery, including the same statutory reference and deemed acceptance without further corporate action."}]}
